w1.recipe_scope: decode-only diagnostic; not the required full W1 MTP envelope

decision_rule: Pass only when actual coverage-bound CPU workload is TOUCHED and names the executed default-ON knob reads, the footprint records default_after flips, and W1 receives a T1 classification with an execution witness. Missing data or ambiguous coverage is UNKNOWN; no rate or promotion claim.
remaining_before_publish: Resolve and bind historical INF-70 model or demonstrate an equivalent exact-identity copy by digest.
Implement and test the coverage-to-knob-read and blast-radius classification producer; bind its revision and hashes.
Prepare pinned experimental coverage builds for baseline and candidate; bind compiler, flags, source commit and resulting loaded DSO digests.
Construct model-server requests and observations for both required workloads and production shape envelopes, including W1 MTP; verify actual device residency during requests.
Implement bounded cleanup, resource, admission and result contracts; independently review and seal the actual runnable packet before rowflow publication.
